value.rationale: The minimum resolving-set reconfiguration graph of the Fano incidence graph is a canonical finite test case for optimal landmark mobility. The structural partition into 56 disjoint triangles, symmetry uniformity, five-step worst-case distance, and sharp one-extra-token-jump detour bound reveal intrinsic optimal-solution geometry not supplied by metric-dimension values or base counts. These exact natural invariants support comparative studies of metric-basis exchange and constrained sensor repositioning.
